en: Wearing rubber-soled shoes prevents slipping on wet floors because rubber increases friction between your feet and the ground.
Never touch electrical switches with wet hands because water conducts electricity and can cause a dangerous shock.
Wearing light-colored cotton clothes in the Philippines helps keep you cool by reflecting the sun's radiant heat.
Looking directly at the sun without certified eclipse glasses can permanently damage the light-sensitive cells in your eyes.
Listening to loud music through earphones for long periods can permanently damage the tiny hair cells in your ears.
Storing heavy objects on lower shelves prevents them from falling and causing injury due to the pull of gravity.
Swallowing small magnetic beads can cause severe internal injuries because the magnets attract each other through intestinal walls.
Using an inclined ramp to load heavy boxes reduces the lifting force needed and prevents back injuries.
Eating carbohydrate-rich foods like rice provides your body with the chemical energy needed for daily physical activities.
Unplugging appliances by pulling the plastic plug instead of the cord prevents internal wires from breaking and causing shocks.
Using thick oven mitts when touching hot pots prevents heat conduction from burning your hands.
Applying oil to a rusty bicycle chain reduces friction, making it easier and safer for you to pedal.
